SCE.S:621054: My high school girlfriend, met again after 12 years. Married after I left the City; single now.
SCE.S:621120: Sent to the mine 2 months ago when his predecessor quit. Before, he guarded an Old Town building.
SCE.S:6211EC: Seeing a real monster's corpse shocked him. He'd heard of monsters at the church and plant, but never believed it.
SCE.S:6212B8: Fourth agent, sent in secret by officials who sensed the City's anomaly. A hero of the last war.
SCE.S:621384: Famous detective of many tough cases; old-school legwork. These serial cases baffle him.
SCE.S:621450: Hasn't been outside for days. Eats the moss in the tunnels. Has forgotten his place in society.
SCE.S:62151C: With the "change," the mine called him. On the way he saw a huge Earth floating over the City.
SCE.S:6215E8: East-coast college grad, home as a dermatologist at New Town Public Hospital. Hates the occult.
SCE.S:6216B4: Works at a Tuscan place in the Old Town, though from New York. Changed, he recalls his Tuscan grandpa's life.
SCE.S:621780: Teacher; Ricardo's drinking buddy. Ricardo changed first, but his mind has "changed" too.
SCE.S:62184C: A national swimmer in school, then on a paper firm's team. Now she swims a sea of mind.
SCE.S:621918: Brokerage clerk. Before her body changed, she lured coworkers to the mine. Talks to plants.
SCE.S:6219E4: Has nearly forgotten who he is. Memories of others in the mine are starting to mix in.
SCE.S:621AB0: She collects and records the forms of "change," correcting it when it strays from its path.
SCE.S:621C48: Changed into a traffic cop for new-dimension data, "explaining" events.
SCE.S:621D14: He halted his own "change" to stay in this world and guide those in its first stages.
SCE.S:621DE0: The mine's second level holds the Catapult of Consciousness. He screens who may pass.
SCE.S:621EAC: A radical. Thinks many sacrifices are fine for the few who "change" correctly.
SCE.S:621F78: At its largest, its body began "changing" into fine particles. It will end as pure waves.
SCE.S:65C834: {6}May I help you? ...From the newspaper? How unusual, out here. It's been a long time since this place was closed.
SCE.S:65C9C8: Something is hidden in this mine. I looked through the library records. It was closed when you were a kid, wasn't it? There seems to have been a big accident. Now, I'd like to go in from here...
SCE.S:65CBA4: {6}You're an ordinary human, aren't you? What a curious one, coming to a place like this. ...Will you join us? Don't hold back.
SCE.S:65CDC8: The door has a {8}lock{2} on it! The caretaker says the company never left him a {8}key{2}!
SCE.S:660834: {6}May I help you? ....I'm sorry... but I've been strictly ordered to let no one inside.
SCE.S:6609BC: Freeze!!! .....What... it's you... Did the caretaker spot you? He was armed with a rifle. You'd better be careful from here.
SCE.S:660B70: {6}I thought you would come here! You're a person of concern. I can't read your thoughts. I haven't changed that far myself. ...Anyway, I can't let you pass beyond here!
SCE.S:660DA4: {6}I guard the "seeds." A "seed" enters you and changes you from the inside! Begin to walk the road of "change"! From the inside toward the outside! From a tiny point toward the stars! Toward countless dimensions!
SCE.S:660FB4: {6}If you insist on going in... it can't be helped.
SCE.S:661090: The door is open, but it seems like a trap! ...I'll contact my superiors, so you'd better not go in!
SCE.S:661168: {6}Welcome! We welcome you with all our hearts.
SCE.S:661254: {6}Were you called too? I'm starting not to understand... I'm confused. ...You're different!
SCE.S:661374: {6}Don't go down! You should meet the "Teacher"!
SCE.S:661408: {6}Only the chosen may go past here!
SCE.S:6614F0: {6}You understand nothing! Don't get in our way!
SCE.S:6651F4: There was an "incident"... This area is off limits.
SCE.S:665348: Hello there. From the newspaper? It was terrible inside. Fifty bodies lying around. We've closed it for the crime scene investigation.
SCE.S:6654E0: But the shafts further down are still locked! My gut says there's still something there! Don't you know anything?
SCE.S:665660: Is this the door back to the surface? But it's locked! Let's go farther down.
SCE.S:6657D8: {5}There's a mutant corpse. The body is slowly... breaking down into light.
SCE.S:6659A0: So this is... the {7}Yamasaki Mine{2}? What a strange feeling! The town's underground is connected like this.
SCE.S:665BB0: Not toward the elevator! I feel something beyond the door! Don't you feel like you can hear voices? Let's go this way!
SCE.S:665DC4: Doesn't it feel stuffy? The space seems to be narrowing. And from deeper in, it's like someone is calling out...
SCE.S:665FD4: Sorry, wait a moment. ...I feel sick..... ..... ...I'm okay, it's better now! ...Let's go!
SCE.S:666154: Oh, you're the one who found it first. The reporter, right! In over twenty years I've seen all kinds of scenes, but never anything like this!
SCE.S:666240: I looked at the {7}mine{2} plans, and there seems to be another level underground.
SCE.S:669834: {6}You're one of our "comrades"... Please don't come and go too openly yet.
SCE.S:669A54: {6}If you're going back to town, there's a {7}station{6} nearby. ...Once the change goes further, you won't need to ride trains to get around, but...
SCE.S:669BAC: {6}Used to your new senses? Go up from here and you're on the surface. The light is a little bright, but you'll get used to it soon!
SCE.S:669D5C: {6}You have a mission to spread the word. Head into town! ...But don't stop by the hospital.
SCE.S:669E6C: {6}How does it feel to have "awakened"? I adjusted your wavelength. Because the "change" is so rapid, many people suffer disorders of mind and body.
SCE.S:669FD8: {6}It's closer if you go down by the {8}elevator{6} in the shaft!
SCE.S:66A070: {6}Your wavelength still seems unsettled. You should tune it more.
SCE.S:66A114: {6}Strange! I can tell what you're thinking. Your perception must be changing.
SCE.S:66A1C4: {6}I have to hurry to the Catapult of Consciousness! I don't want to be left behind!
SCE.S:66A270: {6}Do you know the Catapult of Consciousness? I think it's farther down.
SCE.S:66A314: {6}Even at this very moment, I exist in three places at once.
SCE.S:66A3B4: {6}Have you been registered? Here we're surveying how far the change has progressed.
SCE.S:66A46C: {6}Look in the tank! We break down those who didn't "change" properly and rebuild them!
SCE.S:66A524: {6}If there's anything you don't understand, ask me anything. If speaking with the mind is hard, you may use your voice.
SCE.S:66A5F4: {6}I'm sorry, but only the chosen can go past here!
